content: GitHub Copilot coding agent: assign an issue, it plans, opens a PR, writes code, runs repo tests/linters, pushes commits iteratively, then requests human review; revises PR on review feedback across cycles. Governance: can only push to copilot/-prefixed branches, no write to main, all changes via PR, assigner cannot approve own agent PR (four-eyes). Task-readiness of the issue strongly affects success.
